# Garment-dyed twill overshirt

We're sorry. This item has been so popular, it has sold out.

View Full Details

### Product Details

Our design team combed through our archives for a traditional heavier-weight shirt that can be worn on its own or as a lightweight shirt-jacket. Built with substantial stretch cotton twill, this is the perfect piece to wear over a tee or under other layers. It's garment-dyed for highs and lows at the seams and will fade gently over time depending on how you wear it.

- 97% cotton/3% elastane.
- Point collar.
- Due to the saturated color of this garment, we recommend washing separately and wearing with similar or darker shades, as color transfer may occur on lighter garments.
- Machine wash.
- Imported.
- Item CI472.

### Size & Fit

**Fits true to size** based on [58 reviews](https://www.jcrew.com/p/mens/categories/clothing/shirts/heritage-twill/garment-dyed-twill-overshirt/CI472#product-reviews)

- Relaxed fit.

Find your fitVIEW SIZE CHART

### Ratings & Reviews 4.8             [58 reviews](https://www.jcrew.com/p/mens/categories/clothing/shirts/heritage-twill/garment-dyed-twill-overshirt/CI472\#product-reviews)

4.8

**Fits true to size** based on [58 reviews](https://www.jcrew.com/p/mens/categories/clothing/shirts/heritage-twill/garment-dyed-twill-overshirt/CI472#product-reviews)

### What customers are saying:

Customers really like this overshirt for its heavyweight twill, sturdy build, and versatile style that works well as a layering piece or light jacket. The fabric, stitching, and overall quality get a lot of praise, and many mention it feels comfortable, durable, and easy to dress up or down. Fit is generally described as easy and slightly roomy, with a few customers sizing down for a trimmer look or noting it runs a bit large. Color choices and the garment-dyed finish are also a hit, making this feel like a classic staple for cooler weather.
